newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Magnum Gold jumps in heavy trade.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Magnum Gold jumps in heavy trade.

text.p: Shares of Sydney-based gold and minerals explorer Magnum Gold NL jumped on thin volume in morning trade after a line of stock totalling about 20 percent of the company's issued capital was put through the market.
At 2.00 p.m. (0300 GMT), Magnum shares trading at eight cents, double Tuesday's closing level.
Dealers said Sydney broker Dicksons put through a parcel of 12.04 million shares at 4.3 cents each.
A spokeswoman from Dicksons said the broker had no comment on the transaction which was handled by one of its private client advisers.

A list of Magnum's shareholders dated April 10, 1996 lists the company's three major shareholders as Carbon Minerals NL with 43.44 percent, Magnum Resources Pty Ltd with 25.03 percent and Boobora Investments Pty Ltd with 9.33 percent.
Magnum has mineral exploration interests in the Northern Territory, New South Wales, Western Australia and Queensland.
